messages:
linda: FYI — incidentbot didn't page oncall for prod-e2 egress-timeout alerts between 03:14-03:27 PST. Customers reported spikes of 502/504. Anyone triaging?

samir: I saw the alerts in the alerting dashboard but no pages went out. I manually paged the phone numbers at 03:22. :confused:

ops-bot: incident created INC-9831. outgoing webhook POST to pagerflow returned 504 for several attempts.

```
POST /integrations/pagerflow 504 Gateway Timeout
headers: {"content-length": "258432", "x-request-id": "req_0a1b2c"}
response: "upstream read timeout"
payload_bytes=258432
```

akshay: digging in — looks like failing deliveries have attachment_size ~258KB in header. Our pagerflow proxy seems to choke on >250KB payloads (buffering -> upstream timeout). The incidentbot started forwarding full attachments in last week's deploy (flag: include_attachments=true).

emma: I didn't get paged. My subscription mapping didn't match the new selector used by the bot (it only matched severity:high, not include_attachments). @akshay can you confirm mapping change?

linda: rolling a quick mitigation — disabling attachment forwarding on incidentbot for prod-e2. Command I ran: `curl -X POST https://infra-api.local/incidentbot/config -d '{"include_attachments":false}'` — pushed and restarted the worker.

ops-bot: deploy check: incidentbot config change deployed to staging 03:31, prod rollout started 03:33, healthchecks green. :white_check_mark:

samir: confirmed manual pages delivered to emma and oncall_jane after the manual page at 03:22. Customer impact summary so far: ~120 failed egress requests, ~3 customers reporting elevated error rates during the window. No SLO breach yet but customer-visible.

emma: taking incident. I'll do a handoff to night oncall at 04:00 and start a postmortem doc. Action items: 1) ensure pagerflow proxy accepts chunked attachments or bot chunks; 2) update oncall mapping to match new selectors; 3) notify affected customers. Assigning follow-ups to @linda (postmortem + customer comms) and @akshay (pagerflow rules).

linda: acknowledged. Creating postmortem ticket PMT-452 and linking the runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PMT-452. Preliminary severity: Sev2. ETA for full fix (chunking + integration tests): 24h.

ops-bot: reminder: run the post-incident checklist `/playbook incidents/pagerflow-attachments` and attach logs.

emma: +1 — I'll file the customer notice and add the timeline. Closing live triage; keeping channel open for handoff notes. Thanks everyone for quick mitigation.

oncall_jane: I have the handoff and will monitor overnight. If anything spikes I'll escalate to the oncall rotation. :eyes:

linda: adding final note — we'll also add an alert when pagerflow returns >=3xx/4xx for outgoing webhook to avoid silent drops next time.
